newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan urges China to step up crackdown on drugs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan urges China to step up crackdown on drugs.

text.p: Taiwanese Justice Minister Liao Cheng-hao on Sunday urged rival China to intensify its crackdwon on drugs, saying most of island's narcotics were smuggled from the mainland.
Liao also said law enforcement authorities in Taipei and Beijing should work together to fight against illegal drug smuggling in the Taiwan strait, state-funded Central News Agency reported.
It would hurt the health of mainland compatriots if communist China does not take effective action against the crime, the agency quoted Liao as saying.
Liao made the comments in an anti-drug campaign in Taipei.
Taiwan and China have been rivals since a civil war spilt them in 1949. Beijing regards the island as a renegade province.
